text: ポケモンは　タイプに　よって　とくいな　タイプ　にがてな　タイプが　いるなり

structure.jp: にがてな　タイプが　いるなり
structure.en: and types they are weak against exist

patterns.name: 〜によって
patterns.explanation: によって after a thing says the result changes from one such thing to another. タイプに　よって = 'depending on the type'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: なり is a very old-fashioned way to end a sentence firmly, like だ, used here as this speaker's odd way of talking. いるなり = 'there are'.
